reason: The free tier already does a 15-page site on desktop and iPhone, and for anything more I'd just write a Playwright script with a cron job. Paying a monthly fee for something I can run myself isn't going to beat my other bills.
objection: It's a new service with no reviews, and my clients don't ask me for dated screenshots or change alerts, so I can't pass the cost on to anyone. If I'm not using it every week, it's gone the month after anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A client actually asking for monthly visual proof of their site, or getting burned by a change I missed, so the $79 lifetime Studio deal pays for itself on one job.
